candidates.core: Preserve the latest actionable lifecycle tag beside the current live channel during follow and explicit Inspector focus.
constraints: reuse existing live_surface_title_line/live_phase_anchor and ActivityKind mapping
no per-block borders, extra rows, parser, virtualizer, execution state, or Tab changes
keep HOLD/FOLLOW, queue, approval, Enter, Esc/Ctrl-C semantics and cell-width bounds

validation: lifecycle badge remains visible with live Answer/Reasoning under Inspector

recommendation: Reject per-block borders and Tab focus; validate the smaller lifecycle-badge experiment against current title and Inspector anchors.
